planner_plan.bridge_text: 正如你所好奇的那样，大树的秘密正等待着被揭开。让我们穿过那层薄薄的寒霜，回到莉娜站在大树下的那一刻。

planner_plan.bridge_text: With Mosk’s name tucked safely in our memories, we turn back to the top of those winding stairs. The old fox watches Lina, waiting to see what she will do next.

replacement_segments.text: Mosk gestured firmly toward the door, but Lina stood her ground. Reaching into her pocket, she pulled out the very last apple of the season and placed it gently on the step between them. This is for the trouble of walking me down, she said softly. Mosk stared at the crisp red fruit for a long moment, his expression softening, until he finally adjusted his vest and stepped aside to let her pass.

Down in the depths of the tree, the humming resolved into a faint, melodic song. On a bed of soft moss lay a firefly as large as a robin, her golden glow flickering and dim. Mosk’s whiskers trembled as he looked at her. He whispered that she had been his dear friend long ago, and that his heart had been heavy with shame ever since he failed to bring her medicine during a harsh winter, leaving him to guard this tree in solitude.
